articles.title: Algorithmic Capital And The Inevitable Rise Of The Chief Creator Officer
articles.summary: Brands are now hiring creators into executive roles as social platforms make earned attention harder to buy. Blenders Eyewear named creator Jordan Howlett its first Chief Content Officer, while Edelman appointed a Global Chief Creator Officer. Brands are bringing creator expertise in-house rather than relying solely on campaign partnerships. These roles reflect growing demand for people who understand how to build trust and engagement in algorithm-driven feeds. Creator marketing is now a more embedded part of brand strategy.

articles.title: Moving Back Home After College? All Your Friends Are Doing It
articles.summary: More young college graduates are moving back home as entry-level job prospects weaken and housing costs remain high. More than 25% of college graduates ages 23-27 lived with their parents last year, up from about 18% in 2001. Recent graduate unemployment reached 5.7% in Q2, compared with a much slower rise in overall unemployment. The trend is also becoming more socially accepted as more young adults use living at home to reduce expenses and take more time to find the right job.

articles.title: What It Actually Takes to Win on Reddit: Lessons from Sonos
articles.summary: Sonos built its Reddit presence around employee Keith Nieves rather than a corporate account. During an app update crisis, he kept recurring office hours running and shared a public Trello-style tracker showing what was being fixed. He also maintains direct relationships with subreddit moderators and brings highly upvoted feedback into product meetings.

articles.title: Content Prioritization in an AI Search Era: A Framework + Worksheet
articles.summary: AI search makes content prioritization more important as generic information can often be answered without a click. This guide outlines which types of content are more likely to retain value, including original research, current information, and content that helps users make decisions or take action. It also identifies content that can be deprioritized when AI can easily replicate it. A downloadable worksheet is available to help teams assess their own content.

articles.title: 11 best alternative search engines to Google in 2026
articles.summary: Search engines have four layers: the query interface, web index, ranking system, and answer layer. Most alternatives, including DuckDuckGo and Startpage, use Bing or Google's index behind a different interface, while only a few, like Brave and Europe's emerging EUSP, crawl the web independently. Comparing alternatives by interface alone can be misleading, and a 12-query test found DuckDuckGo's no-AI mode closest to Google's results despite relying on Bing.

articles.title: Use Chrome Dev Tools to emulate how ChatGPT + Claude see your site
articles.summary: Chrome DevTools can show how AI crawlers view a site by changing the browser's user agent. In DevTools, open Network Conditions, paste the user agent string for an LLM like ChatGPT or Claude, and refresh the page. This reveals how AI systems receive site content compared with human visitors, which is becoming more useful as sites serve AI-specific versions of their pages.

articles.title: Consumer focus on protein, digestion and health is reshaping the dairy aisle
articles.summary: Dairy is being reshaped by demand for protein and digestive health. High-protein, low-sugar, and lactose-free options are gaining traction, while social media is driving new uses for cottage cheese and butter. Brands are also expanding premium products and cooking-focused formats as more people eat at home. Cottage cheese is emerging as a major growth area, with demand outpacing supply and prompting manufacturers to expand capacity.

articles.title: Time's AI-only ads may be marketing's next frontier
articles.summary: Time magazine runs a machine-only version of TIME.com that serves sponsored content to AI crawlers instead of humans. Bots like ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot, and PerplexityBot see marketing claims and FAQ-style content promoting Ally Bank, while Google's crawler gets the standard page. Since June, an adtech partner has reformatted pages into “agent ads” designed to influence AI assistant responses rather than individual readers.

articles.title: Cognitive Pollution: Real knowledge only forms through doing the work
articles.summary: Cognitive pollution is the growing volume of AI-generated content that appears useful but lacks the context that comes from doing the underlying work.

articles.title: X replaces ‘misaligned' revenue sharing program with Original Content Rewards
articles.summary: X is replacing its Revenue Sharing program with Original Content Rewards, ending new signups and phasing out existing payouts by September 7.

articles.title: Do everything vs. master one thing
articles.summary: AI is making marketing generalists more valuable.
